edits.modify_from: Identify the starting highlighted target and each successive reached target using highlight changes together with sustained wrist motion.
edits.modify_to: Identify the starting target and each successive reached target using highlight changes together with sustained wrist motion. Treat marker labels such as 'highlighted area' and 'highlighted target' as possible references to lattice targets: identify their lattice cells from their positions, not their label wording. Include the starting target as the source of the first transition, and assign both source and destination to lattice rows and columns before encoding each move.

revision.refused: Omit the trajectory-specific coordinates and redundant restatements of direction encoding, same-column classification, serialization, and update timing. Those rules already explicitly determine B for a backward transition within one column and remain unchanged, consistent with the earlier rounds. Commit only the clarification that target identification must not depend on marker label wording. No annotation, additional field, or subgoal-policy prompt change is needed.
